direction_convention: edges point from temporally/prerequisitely prior support state toward downstream or replacement state; supersession therefore means prior -> replacement

relation_types.contrasts: the source state is a comparison baseline that must be distinguished from the downstream state
relation_types.governs: an applicable rule/assessment constrains the downstream action or conclusion
relation_types.prerequisite: source is required before the downstream operational state
relation_types.preserves_uncertainty: source branch remains viable and is intentionally carried into downstream assessment/action
relation_types.qualifies: source evidence determines applicability or limits certainty of downstream interpretation
relation_types.resolves: downstream evidence resolves an earlier ambiguity
relation_types.supersession: prior diagnosis/procedure/work-order state is replaced by the downstream state
relation_types.supports: source evidence supports the downstream evidence/conclusion
relation_types.updates: a later decision/action updates an earlier support state
relation_types.verifies: downstream evidence verifies execution/outcome of the source state
